ai_summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd (AIIL) has fulfilled its INR 350 Crore commitment for acquiring identified assets of Wind World (India) Limited. However, a significant pivot occurred as AIIL subsequently invested an additional INR 100 Crore, converted into a 25% equity stake in Vibhav Energy Private Limited (VEPL) – a subsidiary of their consortium partner – due to the original WWIL scheme not being approved by the NCLT. This investment into VEPL, a company with zero turnover for the past three years and negative net worth, represents a material shift and a significant red flag regarding the underlying value and strategic rationale.
